blockingIssues.problem: The research omits the source-stated tension in the baseline Synthesis: it pairs company identity with Compose in its top-level emphasis but later calls orchestration central to the product direction. This is a material qualification when interpreting the candidate’s orchestration-first outputs and the prompt intervention’s result; the source says the tension may have reinforced that angle, while not changing the controlled result.
blockingIssues.sourceQuote: The baseline Synthesis pairs company identity with Compose in its top-level emphasis, but also contains a later description calling orchestration “central to the product direction.” That internal tension may have reinforced the technical angle. This does not change the controlled result: the candidate prompt was not sufficient to protect the supplied editorial intent, and this experiment did not change Synthesis because that was outside scope.
blockingIssues.constraint: Retain both the possible influence of the Synthesis tension and the source’s qualification that it does not change the reported controlled result.
